what_work: What should we work on in {project}?
placeholder: Ask anything or give a task… (/ skill, @ agent)
perm_ask_desc: Always asks before editing external files or using the internet
perm_auto_desc: Only asks for actions detected as potentially unsafe
perm_full_desc: Unrestricted access to all files on your computer
confirm_remove_project: Remove the project and its chats from the list? Files on disk are not touched.
name: Name
pick_folder_hint: Pick the folder where project output is saved. If none, one is created under workspace/.
context_size_hint: Larger context uses more VRAM/RAM on local models. Applied when the model reloads.
theme_desc: Light, dark or follow the system
models_desc: Models used for chat and visual testing
active_model_desc: Switching to a local model unloads other local models
cloud_fallback_desc: Falls back to cloud only if explicitly allowed
context_compress_desc: Old messages are summarized before the context fills up
compress_threshold_desc: Context is summarized automatically at this level (default 80%)
context_local_desc: Read from the model (Ollama /api/show, LM Studio)
default_permission_desc: Approval behavior for agent commands and file changes
agent_limits_desc: Prevents endless loops and runaway resource use
security_note: Note: commands run directly on this computer; the filter is not a sandbox. The approval mode is the real control. Dangerous commands always ask, even in full access.
confirm_delete_provider: Delete this provider and its key?
cloud_providers_desc: Models of enabled providers with a key appear in the picker
add_language_desc: Enter code and English name; en.json is auto-translated
skills_desc: Invoked with / in chat. Markdown instructions are added to the system prompt.
agents_desc: Invoked with @ in chat. Defines the agent role.
import_url_ph: GitHub or https URL (…/SKILL.md, blob/… or tree/…)
err_missing_credentials: API key missing — add it in Settings > Providers
err_forbidden: Not permitted — check key permissions or region (403)
err_terms: Provider terms not accepted — Settings > Test > Read & accept terms
err_payment: Insufficient credits (402) — add credits to your account
err_quota: Quota or credit limit reached — check your plan/balance or retry later
err_rate_limit: Too many requests (429) — wait a moment and retry
err_context_length: Context window exceeded — compress the chat or increase context size
err_no_tools: This model does not support tool calling — switched to text protocol
err_model_not_found: Model not found — check the name or pull it (ollama pull)
err_not_found: Endpoint not found (404) — check the provider URL
err_bad_request: Request rejected (400) — unsupported parameter or invalid input
err_too_large: Request too large (413) — reduce attachments or compress the chat
err_timeout: Timed out — the provider did not respond in time
err_unavailable: Provider unreachable — is the server running and the URL correct?
err_overloaded: Provider overloaded or temporarily unavailable (503/529) — retry
err_bad_gateway: Bad gateway (502) — the routed model is not responding
err_moderation: Content was blocked by the provider's safety policy
err_disabled: Provider disabled — enable it in Settings
err_empty: The model returned an empty response
err_request: Could not send the request to the server
unsaved_change: Unsaved change — press Save or Enter
terms_needed: This key is valid but the terms of use are not accepted yet.
ctx_no_stats: Details appear after the first reply
no_outputs: No files created in this chat yet
confirm_rollback: Files will be restored to snapshot {sha}. This is saved as a new snapshot and can be undone.
model_unavailable: This model is not currently available
available_models_desc: Enabled providers with a key; each loads independently
no_usable_providers: No usable provider — enable one in Providers
vision_unavailable: {m} is not installed/available — pick a vision model from the list
provider_not_usable: Enable the provider and save its key to see models
web_engines_desc: APIs with a key are used first. When there are none, or they find too little, the free ddgs library (Google, Yahoo, Bing, Yandex, Brave), Wikipedia/Wikidata and the built-in engines step in; as a last resort a background browser runs the same search.
brave_desc: Brave Search API key (free tier available)
tavily_desc: Search API built for AI agents
searxng_desc: Your own SearXNG instance URL (JSON output enabled)
web_policy: Results are merged across engines and off-topic ones are dropped. Pages that cannot be read are taken from an archived copy (Wayback Machine). Bot checks are never solved; that engine is rested for a while.
confirm_delete_folder: Folder {name} and everything in it will be permanently deleted.
empty_folder_drop: Empty folder — drag and drop files here
no_history: No snapshots yet (kept for project folders only)
welcome_sub: Your autonomous assistant that writes code, runs commands, tests and researches with local and cloud models. Give me a goal and I'll handle the rest.
compress_busy: Cannot compress while the chat is running; wait for it to finish
cap_tools_native_desc: The model calls tools via the provider's native function calling
cap_tools_text_desc: No native tool support; AI IQ 300 provides tools through its text protocol
cap_thinking_desc: Produces a reasoning trace before answering
no_vision_warning: The selected model has no vision support; attached images may be ignored. Pick a vision model.
model_msg_lms_missing: LM Studio CLI (lms) not found; the model will load on first request
err_name_exists: An item with this name already exists
err_compress_busy: Cannot compress while the chat is running
err_approval_stale: This approval is no longer valid
err_root_protected: The root folder cannot be changed
err_forbidden_command: This command is forbidden by the safety policy
err_no_terms: This provider has no terms to accept
err_folder_too_broad: The home folder or a drive root cannot be a project folder; pick a subfolder
err_invalid_item_name: Names may contain only lowercase letters, digits, - and _
err_core_agent: Core agents cannot be deleted (they can be edited)
err_path_escape: This path is outside the working folder
vision_model_no_vision: This model has no vision support; screenshot analysis will not work. Pick a model tagged "Vision".
err_no_model: No model selected — pick one under the message box or add a provider in Settings > Providers
add_chrome_desc: Agent that opens and visually tests pages in a browser
goal_desc: Works on its own with a to-do list until the goal is reached
plan_mode_desc: Plans first, then carries out the plan
drawing_desc: Draw a sketch and send it as an image
draw_hint: Click and drag to start drawing
mm_desc: Use cloud models together: automatic switch when a quota runs out, separate models for agents, and the model handing part of the work to another model.
mm_auto_switch: Switch automatically when a quota runs out
mm_auto_switch_desc: On quota, credit or repeated errors the task does not stop; it continues the same conversation on the most available pool model.
mm_delegate_desc: The running model can hand a sub-task (review, draft, second opinion) to the most available pool model by quota, speed and context.
mm_local_note: Local models are never in the pool: several local models at once can freeze the computer. A local model may call cloud models, never another local model. The system works only while the pool has active cloud models.
mm_pool_desc: Cloud models that may be used and what they are good at. Selection weighs capability, remaining quota, rate limit and context.
mm_empty_pool: The pool is empty. Use Add to add a cloud model.
mm_agents_desc: Each agent can run on its own model; empty uses the model selected in the chat. When the assigned model runs out of quota the agent falls back to the main model.
quota_desc: Last 5 hours and last 7 days per provider; with a limit set, the provider is skipped once it is used up. Remaining allowances reported by the provider are shown too.
mm_local_ignored: Local models cannot be assigned; this agent runs on the main model.
rules_desc: Every chat in this project follows these rules (e.g. "use Tailwind", "PHP 8.2, no frameworks", "comments in English"). They live in AIIQ.md at the project root; when you say "remember this" in a chat, the model adds to it too.
rules_placeholder:
- Use Tailwind CSS for the UI
- Write code comments in English
- Database: SQLite
global_rules_desc: Lasting preferences added to every chat. For project-specific rules use Project rules in the project menu.
global_rules_hint: Saved when you leave the field.
preview_truncated: The diff is very long; only the first part is shown. The full change is in the file after approval.
preview_binary: Binary or very large file; the content cannot be shown.
model_profiles_desc: Override what the provider reports for the selected model. Auto keeps the provider's default; changes are saved at once.
prof_thinking_desc: Off: the model does not think, or its thinking is hidden (faster replies). On: asks for thinking (on Anthropic only in chats without tools).
prof_vision_desc: Whether the model can see images. Correct it here if the provider reports it wrongly.
prof_streaming_desc: Off: the reply arrives in one piece. For servers that have trouble streaming (Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers).
prof_tools_desc: Native: the provider's function calling. Tags: the in-text tag protocol, for models whose function calls fail.
prof_temperature_desc: 0–2. Lower is more consistent, higher more creative.
prof_max_tokens_desc: Most tokens generated in one reply. Empty: provider default.
profile_save_failed: The profile could not be saved
effort_desc_api: Higher effort thinks more thoroughly; it takes longer and uses quota faster. Levels come from the model's API data.
effort_desc_prompt: This model's API offers no effort setting; the chosen level is passed to the model as an instruction.
voice_desc: Answers are read aloud with the voice you choose. Code blocks and links are not read.
voice_unsupported: This browser does not support speech synthesis.
voice_auto_desc: When a task finishes the answer is read aloud. You can also use the speaker under each answer.
voice_none: No installed voice for this language; add one in Windows Settings > Time & language > Speech.
voice_sample: Hello, I am AI IQ 300. I will read your answers with this voice.
mcp_desc: Connect Model Context Protocol servers (GitHub, PostgreSQL, file system, browser...). Their tools are offered to the model automatically.
mcp_empty: No MCP servers yet. Use Add with a command (stdio) or an address (HTTP).
mcp_secret_keep: Saved: {keys}. Leave empty to keep them; type to replace them.
mcp_secret_note: Environment variables and headers (tokens) are kept in the secret store, not in the settings file, and are never sent back to the UI.
mcp_save_failed: The MCP server could not be saved
mcp_safety: Tools marked read-only (green) run without asking; the others ask on every call unless Full access is on. Only add servers from sources you trust.
voice_on_hint: Voice commands on: speak; say "send", "stop", "approve", "deny", "new chat", "read", "quiet".
voice_busy: A task is running; say "stop" first
ai_note_no_native: Native tool calling not supported; switched to the text protocol: {e}
ai_note_leak: Unparsed tool syntax was hidden; the model was asked to retry the call.
ai_budget_note: The step limit was reached ({n} steps) before the task finished. Type "continue" to resume where it stopped; the limit can be raised in Settings > Agent.
ai_note_no_action: ⚠️ No tool ran in this turn: no file was changed and no command was run. The reply below is only the model's claim; repeat your request or pick another model to get it done.
drop_sub: Images, documents, code, videos or folders — added to the chat; folders keep their structure in the working folder.
draw_edit_hint: Click to draw or add text on it
web_shot_desc: Captures a page and shows it in the chat
web_shot_prefix: Take a screenshot of this page:
voice_default_hint: The active language's female neural voice; the browser voice when offline
voice_neural_offline: Natural voices are unreachable (no internet or edge-tts not installed); browser voices are used.
voice_privacy: Natural voices are free and need no key; the text to read is sent to Microsoft's read-aloud service to be spoken. Browser voices work offline and the text never leaves the computer.
voice_per_lang: Saved for {lang} only; other languages use their own voice.
err_network: Network connection lost — check your connection and retry
err_unknown_kind: This provider type is not supported — check the provider settings
cf_account_hint: Shown on the Workers AI page of the Cloudflare dashboard. Use an API token with Workers AI permission as the API key.
err_plan_required: This model needs a paid plan — upgrade your plan or pick another model
ai_note_lang: Fixing words written in another language.
ai_note_lang_done: Words in another language were translated (only the reply was fixed, without a second thinking pass).
ai_note_lang_kept: The reply language could not be fixed; the reply is kept as it was.
google_search_desc: Google Programmable Search (Custom Search JSON API) key; 100 queries a day free
google_cx_desc: Create an engine with "Search the entire web" on at programmablesearchengine.google.com
yandex_folder_desc: The folder ID in the Yandex Cloud console (starts with b1g…)
bing_search_desc: Bing Web Search API v7 (Azure). Microsoft stopped selling it in 2025; existing keys keep working
maps_services_desc: Place search (the places tool): Google or Yandex when a key is set (ratings, review counts, price level); free OpenStreetMap otherwise.
google_maps_desc: Google Places API (New) key; enable Places API (New) in Google Cloud
osm_desc: Nominatim + Overpass: free, no key; address, phone, website, opening hours
changes_partial: The folder is very large; the comparison is partial.
change_by_tool_hint: Changed by the file tools (write, edit, document)
change_by_command_hint: Changed by a command, script, formatter or package manager
